Languages & RTL

العربية · Français · English

Every app switches between Arabic, French and English from the EN / AR / FR pill next to the bell. Arabic flips the whole layout right-to-left: the side menu opens from the right, arrows mirror and Quick access pages swipe the other way.

Al-Arz School (مدرسة الأرز) is a fictional demo school. These are SKL visual mockups taken from the teacher, student and parent prototypes, which share one design system.
Lebanese curriculum: EB & S classes, grades out of 20, Brevet & Lebanese Baccalaureate. Arabic, French and English, with right-to-left for Arabic. Navigation is a side menu with a fixed header. The agenda is the daily school diary: lessons covered, homework, notes for parents and teacher remarks, signed by a parent every evening. Class materials back up the classroom: board photos, notes, slides, short videos, past papers and CRDP textbooks, organised by lesson. Each role has its own accent colour: teacher indigo, student teal, parent coral.
